MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The SanDisk microSD card fits my repeated purchases of removable storage for cameras and my tablet, provided my device supports 256GB cards.",
    "The card reader relates to my history of transferring files from SD and microSD cards, although I already have a reader that meets that need."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Internal SSDs do not serve the same purpose as my removable memory cards; I am not planning a computer storage upgrade.",
    "Ethernet switches and cable packs assume a wired-network project that my camera, tablet, and charging-accessory purchases do not indicate.",
    "Buying surge protectors does not mean I currently need a large battery backup, and owning viewing equipment does not create an immediate need for another HDMI cable.",
    "The larger card reader adds formats I have not shown a need for, while duplicating the SD and microSD reader I already bought."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My electronics purchases seem to have been treated as interest in almost any electronic equipment, regardless of what I would use it for.",
    "Storage products and cables seem to have been grouped together too broadly, despite differences between removable cards and internal drives, or charging cables and networking cables."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated memory-card purchases point to removable storage that works with my existing devices; capacity compatibility matters before I choose a larger card.",
    "My accessory purchases often support equipment I already own, so the specific connection, fit, and purpose matter more than a general electronics resemblance.",
    "Already owning a suitable card reader makes another reader less useful unless it solves a new need."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my interest in electronics and memory cards but stretched it into computer upgrades and networking projects I do not currently need."
}
